status: prospective low-dimensional trans-context design; no localization result used
source: GSE67828 external CAD and N2A expression, retained FinalShot extraction
eligible_channels: Only RBP channels marked context_eligible with finite nonnegative proxies in both cell lines; all others omitted explicitly
proxy: compartment_balanced_expression_proxy: average of soma/neurite median log1p FPKM
normalization: For each cell, divide each eligible protein proxy by the sum across eligible proteins
interaction: Four weighted sums across proteins, one for each signed RBP summary: sum_r delta_rj * normalized_external_availability_rc
comparison: M6 versus M6 plus the four aligned interactions; necessity judged on cross-cell transfer, with both knockout and protein-identity/context permutations
limitations: Transcript abundance is not measured protein availability; normalized profile mass is not absolute occupancy. Aggregate alignment cannot identify an individual causal RBP.
unsupported_cells: Fail closed; no invented expression or zero-filled predictions
